frontier.hypothesis: Some restructuring of the FUNCTION (not of the Case3 arm) can make a variable that is genuinely live in the original semantics happen to be DEAD at exactly the s.p_static store while still carrying exactly one other assignment -- satisfying birthing_insn_p without any dead store.
frontier.mechanism: s6's confirmed predicate is a conjunction of a liveness property and a set-count property of the carrier. Both are function-global properties, not arm-local ones: the s6 sweep only varied WHICH existing local is staged, never WHERE that local's other assignment and its later reads sit. Moving a variable's single other assignment, or moving its later read to before the loop, changes the same predicate without touching the Case3 arm at all.
frontier.next_probe: Extend tmp/grind/func_80060544/s6/carrier_setcount.py with variants that keep the same carrier but relocate its OTHER assignment and its later read (e.g. compute end_off/new_var6/new_var3 after the loops instead of in the prologue; move the initTexPage argument computation; return the expression directly instead of through new_var6). For each, report launch and asm size; anything with launch=1 AND asm_lines==117 is then worth a sandbox run and a cheat-reviewer read. The gate is sub-second per variant.
